doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form for Learning and Development programs and assessments procurement. Specifies submission format, page limits, and evaluation criteria structure for proponent responses across six rated categories: Corporate Profile, Key Personnel and Roster, Curriculum & Program Design Capability, Measurement Approach, Relationship Management, and Value-add, plus Relevant Experience and References.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D1 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – Learning and Development programs and assessments

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup, including profile and history, number of employees, and list and description of off-the-shelf or custom products and services offered, range and depth of experience with each, and core areas of expertise or specialty.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the off the shelf or custom products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing their team, including internal and external resources. Brief profiles (maximum half page each, maximum 4 individuals) for those serving in dedicated relationship or coordination roles with the Bank, including name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Description of practitioner talent available, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, instructional designer or project manager.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D1 - Rated criteria response form.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Key Personnel and Roster

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents describe their approach and experience in designing, developing, delivering and updating learning solutions. evaluation_criteria.title: Value-add

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents provide two (2) examples of relevant projects completed within the last two (2) years, and accompanying references. Each example includes client organization (or anonymized description if confidentiality applies), industry and organizational size, learning and development objectives, services provided by the Proponent, target audience (e.g., executives, people leaders, individual contributors), delivery model (e.g., in-person, virtual, blended), project duration and approximate number of participants, challenges encountered and how they were addressed, measurable outcomes achieved, and client reference including contact name, title, email address, and telephone number.

submission_rules.details: Brief profiles (no more than half a page each, maximum of 4 individuals) for those serving in dedicated relationship or coordination roles with the Bank (e.g., account manager, instructional designer, project manager). Each profile must include name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Description of practitioner talent available internally or externally, including range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, instructional designer or project manager. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D1 - Rated criteria response form.docx

submission_rules.details: Description of approach and experience in designing, developing, delivering and updating learning solutions. Include description of focus and scope of off-the-shelf program offering (programs, workshops, toolkits, resources, digital tools or platforms), list of categories of off-the-shelf products offered, overview of quantity and types of products in each category, how products are accessed (subscription, licensing, pay-per-use, etc.), description of foundational models and frameworks, identification of key assessments, tools, or frameworks used, methodology for analyzing learning needs and identifying competency gaps, approach to designing curriculum frameworks and learning pathways, experience creating customized learning solutions aligned to organizational competencies and business objectives, experience developing blended learning solutions (instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, experiential), distinguishing features of organization's approach with emphasis on learning transfer, behaviour change, participant experience and client alignment, and examples of innovative learning practices.
